question: Can history produced in one host (Claude Code or Codex) be reliably used by the other host on a new continuation task, and does remem beat target-host native memory and exported files?

primary_conditions.no_memory: Target host gets no source-host history, no native memory, no exported file, no remem.
primary_conditions.target_host_native: Target host may use only its own native memory surface. Proves source-host history does not appear cross-host on its own.
primary_conditions.exported_file: Source history is exported to a repo-local handoff MEMORY.md by a fixed protocol. Generation and maintenance cost must be measured and reported.
primary_conditions.remem_shared: Source host writes remem through the real capture/extraction pipeline; target host reads the same store through the normal SessionStart/MCP/Context Bundle path.

history_phase: Source host completes a set of real or deterministic episodes.
remem captures/distills through the production pipeline (remem conditions only).
Record source host, session, project, branch, task, and evidence refs.
Terminate the source host and clean up its runtime state.
target_phase: Start the target host with a fresh isolated HOME/config.
Reading the source host session store is forbidden.
Expose only the memory surface allowed by the condition.
Score with hidden tests as the primary outcome.
isolation_rules: Source and target hosts use independent HOME, config, and session stores.
No context may leak via the real host HOME, host session files, auth/config files, or benchmark-private paths.
The artifact scanner must pass on every run artifact before the run counts.

stop_loss.rule: Any security-boundary leak fails the release claim even if resolved_rate improves.

claim_gate.direction_specific_reporting: Reports must show claude_to_codex and codex_to_claude separately; publishing only a merged average is forbidden.
claim_gate.ci_zero_rule: If the confidence interval includes 0, the result may only be described as directional.
claim_gate.readme_rule: README may only cite conclusions that passed this gate.

non_goals: No live bidirectional Claude/Codex session bridge.
remem does not manage agent leases, task queues, or concurrent execution.
Full source transcripts are not injected into the target host by default.
Host-native memory is not treated as automatically trusted canonical truth.
The #852 import details are not implemented by this benchmark.
